google.boolean-names.summary: Rejects is-prefixed boolean JSON properties, except the documented isNew reserved-word exception.
google.boolean-names.notes: See [Google API rules](../google-api.md) for source AIPs, classification and explicit intent markers. These checks inspect contracts, not runtime behavior.

google.custom-method.summary: Checks custom GET or POST operation names against a matching colon verb suffix and a finite set of prohibited preposition words.
google.custom-method.notes: See [Google API rules](../google-api.md) for source AIPs, classification and explicit intent markers. These checks inspect contracts, not runtime behavior.

google.error-response.summary: Requires a documented HTTP error body with a JSON error envelope containing integer code and string message.
google.error-response.notes: See [Google API rules](../google-api.md) for source AIPs, classification and explicit intent markers. These checks inspect contracts, not runtime behavior.

google.field-names.summary: Requires lowerCamelCase JSON property names, with exceptions for ProtoJSON Any @type and arbitrary map keys.
google.field-names.notes: See [Google API rules](../google-api.md) for source AIPs, classification and explicit intent markers. These checks inspect contracts, not runtime behavior.

google.http-method.summary: Requires GET for standard Get/List, POST for Create, PATCH for Update and DELETE for Delete operations.
google.http-method.notes: See [Google API rules](../google-api.md) for source AIPs, classification and explicit intent markers. These checks inspect contracts, not runtime behavior.

google.list-request.summary: Requires optional pageSize integer and pageToken string query parameters on standard List requests.
google.list-request.notes: See [Google API rules](../google-api.md) for source AIPs, classification and explicit intent markers. These checks inspect contracts, not runtime behavior.

google.list-response.summary: Requires List success objects with one resource-object array and a string nextPageToken.
google.list-response.notes: See [Google API rules](../google-api.md) for source AIPs, classification and explicit intent markers. These checks inspect contracts, not runtime behavior.

google.long-running-response.summary: Checks explicitly marked long-running operations for an Operation object declaring name, done, error and response fields.
google.long-running-response.notes: See [Google API rules](../google-api.md) for source AIPs, classification and explicit intent markers. These checks inspect contracts, not runtime behavior.

google.method-name.summary: Checks UpperCamelCase operation IDs with action and resource words and rejects the Async word.
google.method-name.notes: See [Google API rules](../google-api.md) for source AIPs, classification and explicit intent markers. These checks inspect contracts, not runtime behavior.

google.request-body.summary: Rejects bodies on Get, List, Delete and other GET operations; requires a resource object body on Create and Update.
google.request-body.notes: See [Google API rules](../google-api.md) for source AIPs, classification and explicit intent markers. These checks inspect contracts, not runtime behavior.

google.resource-name.summary: Requires string name in synchronous resource responses and explicitly marked resource schemas.
google.resource-name.notes: See [Google API rules](../google-api.md) for source AIPs, classification and explicit intent markers. These checks inspect contracts, not runtime behavior.

google.resource-response.summary: Requires object success responses on synchronous Get, Create and Update operations.
google.resource-response.notes: See [Google API rules](../google-api.md) for source AIPs, classification and explicit intent markers. These checks inspect contracts, not runtime behavior.

google.standard-path.summary: Checks resource-variable endings for Get/Update/Delete and collection-literal endings for List/Create, with explicit singleton handling.
google.standard-path.notes: See [Google API rules](../google-api.md) for source AIPs, classification and explicit intent markers. These checks inspect contracts, not runtime behavior.

google.timestamp.summary: Requires properties ending in Time to use type string and format date-time.
google.timestamp.notes: See [Google API rules](../google-api.md) for source AIPs, classification and explicit intent markers. These checks inspect contracts, not runtime behavior.

google.update-mask.summary: Requires an optional string updateMask query parameter on standard Update operations.
google.update-mask.notes: See [Google API rules](../google-api.md) for source AIPs, classification and explicit intent markers. These checks inspect contracts, not runtime behavior.

google.version-path.summary: Requires a major-version path prefix such as /v1, /v1beta or /v1beta1.
google.version-path.notes: See [Google API rules](../google-api.md) for source AIPs, classification and explicit intent markers. These checks inspect contracts, not runtime behavior.

openapi.auth-required.summary: Requires effective security for each operation unless its operation ID is explicitly public.

parameters.public-operations: Operation IDs allowed to omit effective authentication.

openapi.enum-values.summary: Checks declared enum values for consistency with their schema and duplicate members.

openapi.error-response.summary: Requires at least one documented client, server or default error response and optionally checks its canonical schema reference.

parameters.error-schema: Canonical schema name required in error-body references; empty disables reference-name checking in openapi.error-response.

openapi.examples-valid.summary: Validates supported OpenAPI media examples and schema examples against their declared schema within bounded local references.

openapi.info-contact.summary: Requires the API info object to declare contact metadata.

openapi.info-description.summary: Requires a nonblank API info description.

openapi.info-license.summary: Requires the API info object to declare license metadata.

openapi.operation-description.summary: Requires a nonblank description on each declared operation.

openapi.operation-id.summary: Requires operation IDs when enabled and checks an optional regular expression against declared IDs.

parameters.pattern: Optional Go regular expression for operation IDs.
parameters.required: Require a nonempty operation ID; true by default.

openapi.operation-id-unique.summary: Reports duplicate nonempty operation IDs across the document.

openapi.operation-success-response.summary: Requires each operation to declare a response in one of the accepted status classes.

parameters.classes: Accepted HTTP response class prefixes, such as 2 and 3; default [2, 3].

openapi.operation-summary.summary: Requires a nonblank summary on each declared operation.

openapi.pagination.summary: Checks pagination fields on classified List/Query operations and explicitly named collection operations.

parameters.collection-operations: Nonempty list of operation IDs treated as collections; required for this general check.
parameters.max-results-field: Name of the maximum-results field or parameter; default maxResults.
parameters.next-token-field: Name of the next-token field or parameter; default nextToken.
parameters.pagination-field: Name of the containing pagination object; default paginationContext.

openapi.parameter-description.summary: Requires nonblank descriptions on declared path-level and operation-level parameters.

openapi.parameters-unique.summary: Reports duplicate parameters identified by name and location, while respecting operation-level overrides.

openapi.path-naming.summary: Requires kebab-case literal path segments, excluding path variables and supported standard .well-known and jwks.json segments.

openapi.path-parameters.summary: Requires every path-template variable to have a required path parameter and rejects unused declared path parameters.

openapi.path-syntax.summary: Checks leading slashes, duplicate separators, empty path variables and malformed template braces.

openapi.property-camel-case.summary: Requires schema property names to use camelCase.

openapi.ref-siblings.summary: Reports unsupported sibling fields next to reference objects, respecting applicable OpenAPI version behavior.

openapi.request-response-example.summary: Requires request and response media examples in the public visitor model.

openapi.schema-description.summary: Requires descriptions on visited schema definitions.

openapi.schema-naming.summary: Requires component schema names to start with an uppercase letter and contain letters and digits (PascalCase).

openapi.security-references.summary: Checks security scheme names and OAuth scope references used by effective operation security.

openapi.server-policy.summary: Checks declared server URLs against allowed protocols and optional exact host restrictions.

parameters.hosts: Optional exact server-host allowlist; an empty list permits any host.

openapi.server-variables.summary: Checks templated server-variable declarations, defaults and enum membership.

openapi.spec-structure.summary: Reports basic malformed OpenAPI document structure and parser model errors.

openapi.tags-defined.summary: Checks duplicate declared tags and operation tags that have no top-level definition.

openapi.unused-components.summary: Reports component definitions not reached by the document reference graph.

portos.async-response.summary: Requires Async success bodies to reference the configured identifier object with only one string ID property.

parameters.async-schema: Canonical shared asynchronous identifier schema name; default AsyncIdentifier.
parameters.item-id-field: ID property name used to correlate request and result items; default id.

portos.async-response.notes: See [Portos response contracts](../portos-api.md) and [rule packs](../rule-packs.md) for composition, shared schema shapes and backend contract tests. Schema inspection cannot prove runtime behavior.

portos.batch-contract.summary: Requires Batch request item objects and synchronous response result objects to declare the configured ID field.

parameters.item-id-field: ID property name used to correlate request and result items; default id.
parameters.items-field: Batch request item-array property name; default items.
parameters.results-field: Collection or Batch result-array property name; default results.

portos.batch-contract.notes: See [Portos response contracts](../portos-api.md) and [rule packs](../rule-packs.md) for composition, shared schema shapes and backend contract tests. Schema inspection cannot prove runtime behavior.

portos.batch-outcomes.summary: Requires synchronous Batch results and errors arrays with required request-compatible IDs and a shared error object on each failure.

parameters.error-schema: Canonical schema name required in error-body references; empty disables reference-name checking in openapi.error-response.
parameters.errors-field: Batch failure-array property name; default errors.
parameters.item-id-field: ID property name used to correlate request and result items; default id.
parameters.items-field: Batch request item-array property name; default items.
parameters.results-field: Collection or Batch result-array property name; default results.

portos.batch-outcomes.notes: See [Portos response contracts](../portos-api.md) and [rule packs](../rule-packs.md) for composition, shared schema shapes and backend contract tests. Schema inspection cannot prove runtime behavior.

portos.collection-response.summary: Requires synchronous List/Query success objects with an array of result objects and a pagination context.

parameters.pagination-field: Name of the containing pagination object; default paginationContext.
parameters.results-field: Collection or Batch result-array property name; default results.

portos.collection-response.notes: See [Portos response contracts](../portos-api.md) and [rule packs](../rule-packs.md) for composition, shared schema shapes and backend contract tests. Schema inspection cannot prove runtime behavior.

portos.date-fields.summary: Requires recognized or configured date properties to use an RFC 3339 string date-time schema.

parameters.date-fields: Additional property names treated as dates alongside built-in name heuristics.

portos.date-fields.notes: See [Portos response contracts](../portos-api.md) and [rule packs](../rule-packs.md) for composition, shared schema shapes and backend contract tests. Schema inspection cannot prove runtime behavior.

portos.delete-idempotent.summary: Requires x-portos-idempotent: true on Delete contracts and rejects declared 404/410 responses for absent resources.
portos.delete-idempotent.notes: See [Portos response contracts](../portos-api.md) and [rule packs](../rule-packs.md) for composition, shared schema shapes and backend contract tests. Schema inspection cannot prove runtime behavior.

portos.description-schema.summary: Requires description properties to reference the configured shared description object.

parameters.description-schema: Canonical shared description-object schema name; default DescriptionValue.

portos.description-schema.notes: See [Portos response contracts](../portos-api.md) and [rule packs](../rule-packs.md) for composition, shared schema shapes and backend contract tests. Schema inspection cannot prove runtime behavior.

portos.error-contract.summary: Requires declared client/server/default error bodies to reference a shared object with required code, message, type and integer family 400 or 500.

parameters.error-schema: Canonical schema name required in error-body references; empty disables reference-name checking in openapi.error-response.

portos.error-contract.notes: See [Portos response contracts](../portos-api.md) and [rule packs](../rule-packs.md) for composition, shared schema shapes and backend contract tests. Schema inspection cannot prove runtime behavior.

portos.etag-conflict.summary: Requires 409 and rejects 412 when request headers declare If-Match or If-None-Match.
portos.etag-conflict.notes: See [Portos response contracts](../portos-api.md) and [rule packs](../rule-packs.md) for composition, shared schema shapes and backend contract tests. Schema inspection cannot prove runtime behavior.

portos.name-schema.summary: Requires name properties to reference the configured shared name object.

parameters.name-schema: Canonical shared name-object schema name; default NameValue.

portos.name-schema.notes: See [Portos response contracts](../portos-api.md) and [rule packs](../rule-packs.md) for composition, shared schema shapes and backend contract tests. Schema inspection cannot prove runtime behavior.

portos.open-enums.summary: Requires open enums with varnames, except exact supported closed sort-direction and error-family protocol discriminants.
portos.open-enums.notes: See [Portos response contracts](../portos-api.md) and [rule packs](../rule-packs.md) for composition, shared schema shapes and backend contract tests. Schema inspection cannot prove runtime behavior.

portos.operation-vocabulary.summary: Checks operation IDs for the supported List, Send, Delete, Query, Get and Modify vocabulary with Batch and Async modifiers.

parameters.operations: Permitted operation action vocabulary; default [List, Send, Delete, Query, Get, Modify].

portos.operation-vocabulary.notes: See [Portos response contracts](../portos-api.md) and [rule packs](../rule-packs.md) for composition, shared schema shapes and backend contract tests. Schema inspection cannot prove runtime behavior.

portos.pagination-request.summary: Requires List query parameters or Query body pagination fields for nextToken and maxResults.

parameters.max-results-field: Name of the maximum-results field or parameter; default maxResults.
parameters.next-token-field: Name of the next-token field or parameter; default nextToken.
parameters.pagination-field: Name of the containing pagination object; default paginationContext.

portos.pagination-request.notes: See [Portos response contracts](../portos-api.md) and [rule packs](../rule-packs.md) for composition, shared schema shapes and backend contract tests. Schema inspection cannot prove runtime behavior.

portos.pagination-response.summary: Requires a pagination context object declaring a string next token and integer maximum results.

parameters.max-results-field: Name of the maximum-results field or parameter; default maxResults.
parameters.next-token-field: Name of the next-token field or parameter; default nextToken.
parameters.pagination-field: Name of the containing pagination object; default paginationContext.

portos.pagination-response.notes: See [Portos response contracts](../portos-api.md) and [rule packs](../rule-packs.md) for composition, shared schema shapes and backend contract tests. Schema inspection cannot prove runtime behavior.

portos.path-description.summary: Requires a nonblank description on every request Path Item, including empty Path Items.
portos.path-description.notes: See [Portos response contracts](../portos-api.md) and [rule packs](../rule-packs.md) for composition, shared schema shapes and backend contract tests. Schema inspection cannot prove runtime behavior.

portos.path-kebab-case.summary: Requires lowercase kebab-case literal request path segments; full path variables are excluded.
portos.path-kebab-case.notes: See [Portos response contracts](../portos-api.md) and [rule packs](../rule-packs.md) for composition, shared schema shapes and backend contract tests. Schema inspection cannot prove runtime behavior.

portos.query-graph.summary: Requires Query request query fields to reference the canonical recursive Query graph with comparison, boolean and text-match operators.

parameters.query-schema: Canonical recursive query schema name; default Query.

portos.query-graph.notes: See [Portos response contracts](../portos-api.md) and [rule packs](../rule-packs.md) for composition, shared schema shapes and backend contract tests. Schema inspection cannot prove runtime behavior.

portos.query-request.summary: Requires classified Query operations to use POST with an object request body.
portos.query-request.notes: See [Portos response contracts](../portos-api.md) and [rule packs](../rule-packs.md) for composition, shared schema shapes and backend contract tests. Schema inspection cannot prove runtime behavior.

portos.query-sorts.summary: Checks optional sorts fields in Query request graphs for arrays of closed objects containing required direction and key.

parameters.sorts-field: Optional Query sort-array property name; default sorts.

portos.query-sorts.notes: See [Portos response contracts](../portos-api.md) and [rule packs](../rule-packs.md) for composition, shared schema shapes and backend contract tests. Schema inspection cannot prove runtime behavior.

portos.success-status.summary: Requires a 200 or 202 success response and rejects other declared 2xx success statuses.
portos.success-status.notes: See [Portos response contracts](../portos-api.md) and [rule packs](../rule-packs.md) for composition, shared schema shapes and backend contract tests. Schema inspection cannot prove runtime behavior.

portos.version-prefix.summary: Requires request paths to begin with a positive major version such as /v2 or /v3.
portos.version-prefix.notes: See [Portos response contracts](../portos-api.md) and [rule packs](../rule-packs.md) for composition, shared schema shapes and backend contract tests. Schema inspection cannot prove runtime behavior.
